I couldn't find which dock you use for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups, so I told you that in our DM rather than guessing a number.

I looked through everything you have access to: our DM, #north-team, #north-random, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-qfl-sev1, plus your notes and the North team files. None of them mention Thornbury Cloth Co. or a pickup dock for them, and there are no account files for them that you can open. The only docks mentioned anywhere belong to other customers (door 6 and Door 14 at Quarrendon Freight Lines).

I didn't use the message search or read any channels you're not in. If the dock is in an email or came from the customer's contact, that's the place to check. Once it's written down somewhere you can see, I can look it up for you.
